allowed_skills.description: Use the leaning-book controller to push the blocking neighbour upright and widen the slot if needed.
allowed_skills.name: recover_leaning_slot

allowed_skills.description: Call perception again after contact changes the row so the next insertion skill uses the updated slot estimate.
allowed_skills.name: reobserve_gap

allowed_skills.description: Insert the target book when the re-observed slot is already wide enough.
allowed_skills.name: insert_if_clear

allowed_skills.description: Widen the re-observed slot with the fingertip strategy, then insert the target book.
allowed_skills.name: insert_if_tight

allowed_skills.description: Stop when the row remains unreachable, unstable, or unsafe after recovery attempts.
allowed_skills.name: abort_and_request_help

notes: This scenario uses the Xiaomi VLA as a high-level skill selector, not as a direct torque or joint controller.
The scenario is intentionally narrow so VLA decisions can be compared against scripted routing on the same perception interface.
success_criteria: The leaning neighbour no longer blocks the slot after recovery.
The target book is inserted upright and released.
Other books stay within the repository's disturbance tolerance.
The policy re-observes after recovery before selecting the insertion skill.
task_instruction: Shelve the target book Essential Signals (QC539 C74) between Foundational Systems (QD486 C93) and Selected Craft (Z130 B72). First recover the leaning neighbour that intrudes into the slot, then re-observe the row, and finally choose the correct insertion skill without toppling other books.
